PredictionRecord.title: PredictionRecord
PredictionRecord.description: A personal sonar classification prediction record saved by an authenticated user from a verified Flask /predict API response.

userId.description: The authenticated Firebase Auth UID of the record owner.

predictedClass.description: The human-readable predicted sonar class ('Rock' or 'Mine').

predictedCode.description: The single-letter sonar class code ('R' or 'M') returned by the Flask /predict endpoint.

selectedModel.description: The machine learning model identifier used for inference.

confidence.description: Optional classification confidence in [0, 1], stored only if returned by the Flask backend.

rockProbability.description: Optional probability for Rock in [0, 1], stored only if returned by the Flask backend.

mineProbability.description: Optional probability for Mine in [0, 1], stored only if returned by the Flask backend.

createdAt.description: Firestore server timestamp when the prediction record was saved.

/prediction_history/{predictionId}.description: Stores personal sonar classification history records scoped strictly to each authenticated user.
